protocol.inputs: Full existing 300x300 arrays in data_real, catalog order and prepared-grid sidecar resolutions; no cropping or resampling.
protocol.drop_one_metric: Set each metric to zero in turn; normalize the remaining weights.
protocol.normalization: All weight vectors are nonnegative and normalized to sum to one.
protocol.flag_bonus: Unchanged candidate-only bonus in every weight scenario; a separate flag_bonus_off scenario passes no metadata to the existing ranker, without changing catalog flags.
protocol.tie_policy: Existing rank_candidates order: descending rounded ACI, then descending base score, then stable catalog order. Use ordinal positions for Spearman, matching window_sensitivity.py; no average ranks for tied scores.
protocol.summary_denominator: All 1018 scenarios, including baseline and the separate bonus-off case; random-only summaries use the 1000 draws. Scenario percentages describe this chosen mix, not scientific probabilities.
protocol.precision: ACI is the unchanged ranker's two-decimal output; Spearman and stability percentages are rounded to six decimals; median uses the recorded Spearman values.
protocol.baseline_check: Both complete orders and every ACI must exactly equal the protected ranking JSONs before analysis output can be written.
protocol.limitation: Tests robustness to metric weights, not scientific correctness of the weights or flags; existing DEM resolution and physical-footprint mismatches remain.
